title: UMTHUTHUKISI WE-3D/XR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Umsebenzi

Umuntu ozophumelela uzoba nomthwalo wemfanelo walokhu okulandelayo:

  • Ukuklama nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-3D ne-XR ezisebenza ngesikhathi sangempela kanye nezingxenye zazo eziyinhloko
  • Ukwakha nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo ze-XR ezinkundleni ze-visionOS nalezo ezihambisana nezindinganiso ze-OpenXR
  • Ukusungula nokunakekela izinqubo zokudweba izithombe ngaphansi kwemibandela eqinile yokusebenza nokubambezeleka
  • Ukusebenza ngokulandelela okuhlobene nendawo, ukwenza imephu yomhlaba, ukulandelela izandla, kanye nezinzwa zemishini
  • Ukwenza ngcono inani lezithombe ngomzuzwana, ukusetshenziswa kwememori, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamandla emishinini ye-XR
  • Ukuhlanganisa izinjini ze-3D, ama-SDK omdabu, kanye nama-API aqondene nenkundla ethile
  • Ukuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ezihlobene nokudweba izithombe, ukuvumelanisa, kanye nokuqondanisa endaweni
  • Ukusebenzisana nabaklami, namaqembu omkhiqizo, kanye nonjiniyela bamasistimu
  • Ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni zesakhiwo nasecebweni lobuchwepheshe be-XR lesikhathi eside
  • Ukukhiqiza imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe esezingeni eliphezulu nokubuyekeza ikhodi njengochwepheshe onolwazi olujulile

Amakhono Obuchwepheshe Adingekayo

  • Isisekelo esiqinile ezibalweni ze-3D zesikhathi sangempela (i-aljebra yemigqa, ukuguqulwa kwezinto, ukuvezwa kwezithombe)
  • Ulwazi oluqinile lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zeQiniso Elengeziwe / XR
  • Ulwazi olujulile nge-visionOS kanye nezimiso zayo zokubala okuhlobene nendawo
  • Ulwazi olubambekayo nge-OpenXR (ukuhlanganiswa nesikhathi sokusebenza, izandiso, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zisebenze kuyo yonke imishini)
  • Ukuqonda okujulile kwemiqondo yokudweba izithombe (imijikelezo yokudweba, izinhlelo zokukhanya nemibala, ukuvumelanisa kwe-GPU/CPU)
  • Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphansi kwemibandela yesikhathi sangempela (isabelo sesikhathi sesithombe ngasinye, ukubambezeleka, isikhathi esiphakathi kokunyakaza nokuvela kwesithombe)
  • Izilimi zokuhlela: C++ / Swift / Objective-C (ye-visionOS nezinkundla ze-Apple) / C# (ye-Unity noma amathuluzi asezingeni lenjini) / Rust (yezingxenye ezidinga ukusebenza okuphezulu noma ezisezingeni lenjini, kuyinzuzo enkulu)
  • Izinhlaka: i-visionOS SDK, i-OpenXR, i-Unity, i-Unreal Engine, noma izinjini zangaphakathi ezakhiwe ngokwezidingo, i-Metal, i-Vulkan, noma i-DirectX, izinhlaka zeQiniso Elengeziwe (i-ARKit noma amasistimu afanayo okulandelela endaweni)

Ngawe

  • Iminyaka emi-5 kuya kweyi-10 yolwazi lomsebenzi ekuthuthukisweni kwesofthiwe, ugxile kakhulu ekuhleleni amasistimu e-3D/XR
  • Umlando oqinisekisiwe wokusebenza kumasistimu ayinkimbinkimbi ngokobuchwepheshe nabalulekile kakhulu
  • Ukucabanga okuqinile ngokwe-3D/XR kanye nekhono lokuqonda iziqoqo ezinkulu zekhodi esezikhona
  • Izinga eliphezulu lokunemba, lokuzimela, nokunaka imininingwane; intshisekelo enkulu yokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingelula
  • Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo: Ulwazi ngeQiniso Elixubile noma ngokuklama izixhumi ezibonakalayo ezihlobene nendawo
  • Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo: Iminikelo kumaphrojekthi omthombo ovulekile ahlobene ne-3D, i-XR, noma nemidwebo yekhompyutha

Izigaba Zenhlolokhono

  1. Ingxoxo Yokuqala Yemizuzu eyi-15 — Ingxoxo emfushane mayelana nogqozi lwakho, ukufaneleka kwakho, kanye nokuphendula imibuzo yakho engahlobene nobuchwepheshe.
  2. Izingxoxo Ezimbili Zobuchwepheshe Nomkhiqizo, Ihora Ngayinye — Ukuhlola ngokujulile indlela oxazulula ngayo izinkinga, uhlangene no-CTO wethu kanye/noma nomholi wethu wokwakhiwa kwezixazululo
  3. Ukwazana Neqembu — Ingxoxo ekhululekile yokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhambisana kahle nesiko lethu.

Esikunikezayo

  • Ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje be-XR nobokubala okuhlobene nendawo
  • Ukuphatha ngokugcwele amasistimu esikhathi sangempela ayinselele ngokobuchwepheshe
  • Amaphrojekthi agxile kakhulu kwezobuchwepheshe futhi ayinselele engqondweni
  • Indawo yokusebenza eyazisa ubuchwepheshe bangempela bobunjiniyela futhi egxile kwezobuchwepheshe (akukho mihlangano engenamsebenzi noma imibiko engadingeki)
  • Ukuzimela okukhulu ekuthatheni izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
